info.title: Formspring REST API
info.description: REST API for managing forms, submissions, webhooks, billing, and AI insights. Pair with the MCP server for agent-driven workflows. The REST API and MCP server use the same token abilities, so the permission model is identical whether code or an agent makes the call.

bearerAuth.description: Personal access token created in your account API page. Tokens carry abilities (forms:read, submissions:write, etc.). Each endpoint lists the ability it requires.

public_url.description: Hosted survey URL on the team's short / branded domain

submissions_count.description: Present when the resource was loaded with withCount.

SurveyField.description: A single question field. `id` is required for the builder/renderer; if you omit it the API will generate one for you.

name.description: Submission payload key; slugified from label when missing

template.description: Key from the survey template registry; populates fields/theme/settings

SurveyUpdate.description: All fields optional - partial update. Send `fields` to replace the whole field array.

kind.description: Screen kind from Funnel::SCREEN_KINDS (welcome, question, form-collect, thank-you, ...)

slug.description: URL slug under /u/{slug}; auto-generated when omitted

FunnelUpdate.description: Send `screens` to replace the whole screen array.

FunnelAnalyticsResource.description: Aggregated funnel metrics - sessions, completions, per-step drop-off.

slug.description: Optional explicit slug; auto-generated when omitted

branded_domain_id.description: Bind to a verified branded domain

LinkUpdate.description: Partial update. Omit a field to leave it unchanged.

disabled_at.description: Set to a timestamp to disable the redirect, or null to re-enable

LinkUpsert.description: Idempotent: returns 201 on create, 200 on update of the same slug.

tags.name: Forms
tags.description: Create, read, update, archive, publish, and delete forms.

tags.name: Submissions
tags.description: Inspect, edit, delete, bulk-act on, and export submissions.

tags.name: Automations
tags.description: Create, enable, disable, and run form automations; inspect and replay runs.

tags.name: Surveys
tags.description: Create, read, update, publish, unpublish, and delete surveys. Surveys are a separate product from forms - multi-screen, conditional logic, scoring.

tags.name: Funnels
tags.description: Create, read, update, publish, unpublish, and delete funnels. Includes session analytics and the per-step summary.

tags.name: Links
tags.description: Branded short links + QR codes. CRUD, idempotent upsert, free-text search, query by exact slug, and click analytics.

tags.name: Billing
tags.description: Read-only access to plan, usage, subscription, and invoice info.

tags.name: AI Insights
tags.description: Read AI-generated insights and trigger regeneration.

get.summary: Current user, team, plan, and token abilities

x-codeSamples.label: fetch
requests
x-codeSamples.source:
import os
import requests

response = requests.get(
    "https://formspring.io/api/v1/forms",
    headers={
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['FORMSPRING_TOKEN']}",
        "Accept": "application/json",
    },
    params={"per_page": 10},
    timeout=10,
)
response.raise_for_status()
print(response.json())

x-codeSamples.label: net/http
x-codeSamples.source:
req, _ := http.NewRequest(
	http.MethodGet,
	"https://formspring.io/api/v1/forms?per_page=10",
	nil,
)
req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+os.Getenv("FORMSPRING_TOKEN"))
req.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")

res, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
if err != nil {
	panic(err)
}
defer res.Body.Close()

import os
import requests

response = requests.post(
    "https://formspring.io/api/v1/forms",
    headers={
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['FORMSPRING_TOKEN']}",
        "Accept": "application/json",
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
    },
    json={
        "name": "Contact form",
        "notification_emails": ["ops@example.com"],
    },
    timeout=10,
)
response.raise_for_status()
print(response.json())

x-codeSamples.label: net/http
x-codeSamples.source:
body, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
	"name": "Contact form",
	"notification_emails": []string{"ops@example.com"},
})

req, _ := http.NewRequest(
	http.MethodPost,
	"https://formspring.io/api/v1/forms",
	bytes.NewReader(body),
)
req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+os.Getenv("FORMSPRING_TOKEN"))
req.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

res, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
if err != nil {
	panic(err)
}
defer res.Body.Close()

get.summary: Download submission file via redirect to signed URL (submissions:read)

post.summary: Create webhook (webhooks:write); plaintext secret returned once
Create a survey (surveys:write); requires a paid plan
Create a funnel (funnels:write); requires a paid plan

put.summary: Update funnel; replaces screens when supplied (funnels:write)

get.summary: Free-text search by slug, title, or target URL (links:read)
Look up a single link by exact slug (links:read)
Render the link's QR code as SVG/PNG (links:read)

423.description: Plan does not include AI features

post.summary: Create a new token (tokens:write); plaintext value returned once

delete.summary: Revoke a token (tokens:write); cannot revoke the token in use
